title: Stone Skipping
description: The shoreline pastime of skimming flat stones across the water. Pick a stone, set its tilt and spin, flick it low and chase one more skip across dawn ponds, windy lakes, swelling bays and moonlit tarns. Pond sessions, a daily pond, free skipping and Watch & Learn.
howToPlay: Tap one of the three stones in the tray.
Slide Tilt and Spin: around 12 to 16 degrees of tilt and plenty of spin is a good start.
Press the stone, drag up and let go: a longer pull is a faster throw.
Read the wind and the bright and dark bands of the swell.
Five throws make a session; use Think when you want a suggestion.
